description: Returns a player's offensive snap share each week (the % of his team's offensive plays he was on the field for), the season average, and a trailing average with its change vs the season. Use it to spot role changes before they show in the box score (a committee back taking over, a rookie WR passing a veteran). Seasons 2020-2026, current season updated weekly. Basic plan and above.

player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.
player_id.title: Player Id

season.description: Season year, 2020 or later. Default: the current season.
season.title: Season

trend.description: Weeks in the trailing average compared with the season, 1-18.
trend.title: Trend

name: get_snap_share

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

games.description: Games on the schedule so far.

games_with_snaps.description: Games he played offensive snaps in.

note.description: A sentence for the user saying which plan is needed.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

recent_snap_pct_avg.description: Average over the trailing trend weeks.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

trend_delta.description: Recent average minus season average (positive = growing role).

weekly_snaps.description: Per week: snaps and snap share.

title: Snap share and role trend
